known_before_freeze: Exploratory source04/05/06, B10/11/12/13 and initial C14 records were inspected. These are not prospective validation of this reference selection.
prospective_use: Reference algorithm and seeds are frozen before reserved sequences or the proposed visible-phase C variant are inspected. No score-driven retuning is permitted.
observation_budget: Same exogenous source observations4 and target observations6 when those trajectories provide them. The policy persists across domains; environmental reset never resets its acquired estimate.
adaptive_rule: Fixed initial estimate12. Current raw alternating scalar sums choose action. After actually observed contact, estimate changes by minus sensed action, bounded[-64,64]. No update for omitted return. Decoupled return changes sensed posture explicitly, not the target.
phase_aware_reference: An additional prepared-protocol reference may use the current phase bit only when that public sensor actually exists; it remembers its own successful preparation action and selects its opposite for verify. It never receives MAIN pending state or desired worker.
independence: Each policy owns an independently evolving task environment from the shared reset conditions. Only exogenous measurements/reset events are shared; pending transaction and phase after distinct actions are not forced to MAIN's future.
hidden_state_boundary: Capacity credit and admission law belong only to the task evaluator. Policy.choose receives observations only; Policy.observe receives own post-action consequence only. No reference ever controls a DEE life.
scope: Finite task-model arithmetic, not service execution, native DEE replay, CPU performance or a general intelligence benchmark. Random seeds are not biological/statistical replicates of the one deterministic DEE history.
